tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background in both themes. Never replace with pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, table bodies and menus that sit on `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Table headers, hover rows and quiet panels on `bg` or `surface`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-tint` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-tint`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Carries no meaning, so it may be faint. Never use for input borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary button outlines and any line that marks a control. At least 3:1 on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent. Primary button fill, links and selected states. As text it reads on `bg`, `surface` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills and links.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows and the info status background. Text on it is `text` or `accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label colour on `accent` and `accent-hover` fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on `surface` and `success-tint`. Always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on `surface` and `warning-tint`. Always paired with a clock icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and overdue text and icon on `surface` and `danger-tint`. Always paired with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges, alerts and field errors.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, same in both themes. Print and deck grounds. Not for UI text.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, same in both themes. Deck and print grounds and large type on light fields.

tokens.name: brand-steel
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, same in both themes. Identity fields and the mark on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, same in both themes. Identity fields and the mark on dark grounds. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Fixed brand colour, same in both themes. Type and the mark on `brand-ink` or `brand-deep`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline and closing headline only. Fluid: h1 size on phones, growing with the viewport to this size at 1280px wide. Line height is unitless so it follows the size.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, hero headline only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The firm name beside the mark, and nothing else. Rounded and monoline to sit with the mark. Never add a descriptor line under or beside it.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We keep your books current so decisions rest on clean numbers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Monthly reporting, cash forecasts and board-ready numbers.
styles.usage: Default paragraph. Keep lines to 60 to 75 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Use the address you check most.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels on figures and simulated content.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels. Sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hex values, IDs and reference numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; alert padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and mobile page gutter doubled.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space around the hero headline on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Table cells, full-bleed images and dividers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, alerts and cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large image frames. The maximum radius in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns and dialogs only. Nothing in the page flow carries a shadow.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and focus colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, accordions and opacity transitions. Set to 0 when the visitor prefers reduced motion.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: The only easing curve. Use with `duration-fast` and `duration-base`.
